name: adhd-quest-private-app
description: Private Android and Windows builds of ADHD Quest

scripts.verify: npm run build && node --check app.js && node --check engine.js && node --check scripts/build-web.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
